Sets the instance-wide tag list. Tags are trimmed and duplicates dropped. Tags already on hosts are not changed. Requires admin.settings.manage.

  id={"request"}
  as={"h2"}
  className={"openapi-tabs__heading"}
>
  <Translate id="theme.openapi.request.title">Request</Translate>

<ParamsDetails>
  
</ParamsDetails>

  title={"Body"}
  body={{"required":true,"content":{"application/json":{"schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"tags":{"type":"array","maxItems":500,"items":{"type":"string","maxLength":100}}}}}}}}
>
  
</RequestSchema>

<StatusCodes
  responses={{"200":{"description":"The saved tags."},"400":{"description":"Not an array of up to 500 non-empty tags of at most 100 characters."},"403":{"description":"Missing admin.settings.manage."},"500":{"description":"Failed to save the tags."}}}
>
  
</StatusCodes>
